# Golden Fixtures — Phase 0.4 Characterization Harness

Recorded snapshots of `run_pipeline`'s full observable output, one file per
scenario. Defined in [`tests/golden.py`](../../golden.py), compared by
[`tests/integration/test_golden_fixtures.py`](../../integration/test_golden_fixtures.py),
regenerated by [`scripts/record_golden_fixtures.py`](../../../scripts/record_golden_fixtures.py).

**These capture behaviour as it is today, including the parts known to be
wrong.** They are a change-detector, not a correctness oracle. See
`specs/002-satellite-evidence-parity/pipeline-decomposition-design.md` §8.1.

## Labels

Every fixture carries `_label` and `_label_reason` in its own JSON.

| Label | Meaning | If it flips |
|---|---|---|
| `pinned` | Behaviour the refactor must not move | The change is the bug. Do not re-record — find what moved. |
| `known-wrong` | Expected to change, by a named task | Re-record **as part of that task**, and review the diff in that task's commit. |

Re-recording to make a red suite go green defeats the entire purpose of the
harness.

## Scenarios

| Fixture | Label | Covers |
|---|---|---|
| `healthy_hailstorm` | pinned | The main COMPLETE path — pre/post optical pair, all components run |
| `flood_sar_substitution` | pinned | Post-event optical unusable, SAR substitutes; Component 1 absent |
| `flood_single_polarization` | pinned | VH absent (T0-15) — cross-pol feature and VH indicator stay absent |
| `csm_high_scrutiny_enabled` | pinned | The only coverage of the Component 3 path |
| `partial_cloud_coverage` | pinned | Low `valid_pixel_fraction` with the usability gate set (T0-07) |
| `varied_historical_archive` | pinned | The only scenario where DSI min-max normalization has a real range |
| `no_imagery_weather_only` | known-wrong | WEATHER_ONLY_PRELIMINARY — gains manifest + coverage at `T0R-06` |
| `no_historical_archive` | known-wrong | DSI with no archive at all — score becomes `null` at `T0R-05` |

## What is normalized away

`request_id` (a global counter, so it depends on test ordering), `generated_at`
(wall clock), and `checksum` (a hash over both) change on every run without
anything having changed. Floats are rounded to 10 decimal places — far below any
figure this pipeline reports, far above the arithmetic's noise floor, so a diff
at that precision is real drift rather than a platform artifact.

## Why `varied_historical_archive` exists

Every other scenario's historical archive is five identical values, so
`hi == lo` in `_min_max_normalize` and it returns the `0.5` midpoint whatever
the entropy weights are. Three different causes all produce `dsi_score = 0.5`,
which is why the weight collapse survived unnoticed — no test could tell a
working DSI from a collapsed one. This scenario gives the normalization a real
range, so `T0R-05`'s gate is not vacuous.

It also pins a second defect for later: the archive passed for
`ndvi_deviation` holds **absolute NDVI index values** while the current
indicator is a **deviation** (`pipeline.py`, `historical_ndvi`). Normalizing a
0.45 drop against a 0.62–0.81 index range clips to `0.0`, so this scenario
records a Damage Severity Index of **0.0 for a field that lost 0.45 NDVI**. See
`T0R-05`'s note in `tasks.md`.
